climate.rain_source: GPM IMERG satellite rainfall, scaled month by month to gridMET (4 km, station-informed) (corrected NASA POWER before 2001 and where IMERG has no file)

calibration.explanation: OpenET's satellite estimate of ET in this field's alfalfa years, divided by the textbook full-irrigation figure (FAO-56 crop coefficient x NASA POWER reference ET). The same factor is applied to every strategy.

vulnerability.method: Each part is scaled 0-1 and averaged: hot days (>32 °C, 10 days = 1), frost days in May-September (10 days = 1), the gap between reference ET and rain, how often greenness fell well below its own normal, and how dry the SMAP soil-moisture pixel normally is.

bare.note: Low green cover is not always bare soil: dormant crops and stubble still protect the surface but look brown from space, and snow or floodwater hides the ground.
